title: artifact_offer body (sealed)
description: Share an artifact with the receiver (spec/protocol.md section 5.20): what it is, the ciphertext the Obysphere holds for it, sealed to the receiver's key, and what the receiver may do with it. No key travels: the receiver's is wrapped inside the age file. Starts an exchange that lasts as long as the share. Comes with the feature artifacts. Sealed: derived from actions/artifact_offer.schema.json by spec/conformance/generate.mjs, every x-obi-text field a sealed_text (spec/protocol.md section 9.1). Don't edit it by hand.

blobs.description: The blob's parts, in order, when the ciphertext is over 64 MiB: blob is then the whole, and its id the first part's.

latest.description: true: each new version of the artifact reaches the receiver as an artifact_update. false: the receiver keeps this version.

ask.description: What the sender asks of the receiver about it, in its owner's words.
